author: Pallas, 1773
status: 길잃은새, 지금까지 기록 10건 미만 · 2000년 이후 확인된 기록 없음
habitat: 하천가와 하구 삼각주의 모래 언덕, 평원, 초원
summary: 우리나라에는 한강 하류와 낙동강 하구에 미조로 날아온 기록이 있다. 하천가나 하구 삼각주의 모래 언덕, 평원, 초원 등에 살며, 중앙아시아의 건조한 스텝 지대에 분포한다. 땅 위에 4~6m씩 사이를 두고 무리 지어 둥지를 틀고 알자리에 마른풀을 깔며, 4월 중순~6월 말에 한배에 알 2~4개를 낳는다.

art.subject: Pallas's Sandgrouse (Syrrhaptes paradoxus), adult male: ochre-orange face, throat and line over the eye, smooth grey crown, nape and neck sides; mantle, scapulars and wing coverts pale sandy-buff to greyish buff, boldly barred and blotched black; pale grey breast with a narrow band of fine black bars across its lower edge, which reads as a darker grey band; a large solid black patch across the belly, the vent and undertail pale buff-white; two long, needle-thin central tail streamers. Small bluish-grey bill; dark eye; very short legs and toes covered in pale buff feathering.
art.scene: sand dunes on a Korean river-mouth delta with sparse grass; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, side view standing on sand: ochre-orange face, grey crown and neck, sandy-buff back boldly barred and blotched black, grey breast with a darker band of fine black bars below it, broad black belly patch, long thin tail pins, feathered feet

adult female, side view standing: same shape and black belly patch, but crown, nape and neck sides finely spotted black, a thin black line across the lower throat, no barred band across the breast, upperparts more densely barred black
art.build: Pigeon-shaped ground bird, 38cm including the long tail pins, the body about the size of a feral pigeon; small rounded head, short neck, plump body sitting low on very short legs, so it looks almost legless when standing. Bill tiny and stubby, much shorter than the head. Legs and short toes thickly feathered to the claws, no visible hind toe. Wings long and sharply pointed, the outermost primary drawn out into a fine filament; tail graduated, its two central feathers extended into long thin pins. Flight fast and direct on narrow, falcon-like wings.
avoid: Do not paint long bare legs or visible toes like a pigeon or partridge; the very short legs and toes are feathered to the claws.
Do not give it a short rounded tail; the central tail feathers end in long, needle-thin pins.
Do not make the back plain grey; it is sandy-buff, heavily barred and blotched black.
Do not paint a long bill or a crest; the bill is tiny and the crown smooth.
